description: Send and return for one stereo channel, with a blend between the unprocessed signal and the one that comes back from the effect

params.text: Sets the balance between the unprocessed signal and the signal coming back from the effect
Attenuates and inverts the BLEND input before it is added to the BLEND knob

inputs.text: A control voltage added to the blend, scaled by the BLEND attenuverter
The left channel of the unprocessed audio
The right channel of the unprocessed audio
The left channel coming back from the effect
The right channel coming back from the effect

outputs.text: The left channel of the blended audio
The right channel of the blended audio
The left channel sent to the effect
The right channel sent to the effect

notes: the effect is patched between the send outputs and the return inputs; the audio enters at the inputs and leaves at the outputs
